name: PAD Robin Action Knowledge Base
description: Paste-validated reference of Power Automate Desktop (PAD) Robin actions: every record is a Robin action id with a template, a golden example that pasted into PAD Designer with zero errors, typed input and output parameters, and the sibling selector forms of the same action. Built for use with AI assistants (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT): give the model the golden example and the Type Reference, have it change values only.

fields.actionId: Robin action id: Module.Action or Module.Action.Selector
fields.kind: Action | Condition (IF ... THEN) | Wait (WAIT ...) | While (LOOP WHILE ...)
fields.selector: selector suffix; null when the action has a single form
fields.template: action with empty backtick placeholders for values you must supply
fields.golden_example: the template with placeholder values, pasted into PAD Designer with zero errors
fields.input_params: Robin argument names (these can differ from PAD internal property names), .NET types, required flag, defaults and enum values where known
fields.output_params: output arguments and the variable name PAD assigns by default
fields.constraints: properties fixed by this selector and therefore absent from Robin (e.g. DelimiterType=Standard)
fields.sibling_selectors: other Robin ids of the same action; each exposes a different argument subset
fields.needs_ui_selector: an input is a recorded UI/web element or image; the example uses a placeholder and cannot run as-is
fields.validation: how the golden example was validated, and on which PAD build

regression: all 987 golden examples re-pasted as published on PAD 2.73.00155.26278 (2026-10-08): 83 batches, zero errors
not_included: 139 further selector variants exist in PAD 2.73 but are not in this release: 103 require a recorded UI element or image, 25 require a live mail or work-queue context to validate, 11 are deprecated, removed, or unknown to the Designer. They may be added in a later release.
